CREATE TABLE "public"."Job" (
  "aiIndexed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "applyUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "company" text NOT NULL,
  "companyLogo" text NOT NULL,
  "companyWebsite" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "employmentType" text NOT NULL,
  "externalJobId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "maxSalary" int4 NOT NULL,
  "minSalary" int4 NOT NULL,
  "postedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "requiredSkills" text[] NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Job_requiredSkills_elem_not_null_42133848" CHECK (array_position("requiredSkills", NULL) IS NULL)
)
